races.label: President
races.blurb: President of the United States, Nov. 5, 2024 general election. Harris/Walz (D) and Trump/Vance (R) are shown directly; Kennedy (American), Stein (Green), Oliver (Libertarian), de la Cruz (Peace and Freedom), and write-ins are combined into “Other.”

races.label: Senate (Full Term)
races.blurb: U.S. Senate, full six-year term, Nov. 5, 2024 general election. California's top-two primary sends only two candidates to the general, so this race has no “Other” category — Adam Schiff (D) and Steve Garvey (R) were the only candidates on the ballot.

races.label: Senate (Special)
races.blurb: U.S. Senate special election, filling the remainder of the term through January 2025. Decided on the same Nov. 5, 2024 ballot as the full-term race, with the same two candidates: Adam Schiff (D) and Steve Garvey (R).
